units.source_text: “夫君，事已至此，你我缘分已尽。

en.t: My husband, now that things have come to this, the bond between us is over.

units.source_text: 我会一死了之，但是……但是你也不能活着。

en.t: I will end it by taking my own life, but... but you cannot go on living either.

units.source_text: 你目睹了我的耻辱，我无法忍受你一个人这样活下去。”

en.t: You have witnessed my shame, and I cannot bear for you alone to go on living like this.
